name: claim_credit_lookup
xsql:
SELECT c.order_code                                            AS order_code,
       c.item_code                                             AS item_code,
       Nvl(c.customer_name, '')                                AS customer_name,
       Nvl(c.product_name, '')                                 AS product_name,
       Nvl(c.credit_type_name, '')                             AS credit_type,
       c.period_name                                           AS period_name,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(c.amount, 0), '$#,###0.00')            AS credit_amount,
       Nvl(c.amount, 0)                                        AS credit_amount_raw
FROM   xactly.xc_credit c
WHERE  c.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id
  AND  c.is_active      = 1
  AND  c.period_name    = :v_period
  AND  ( Nvl(:v_order_code, '') = ''
         OR c.order_code LIKE Concat('%', Concat(:v_order_code, '%')) )
ORDER BY c.order_code, c.item_code
